one_line: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk that unifies email, chat, SMS, voice, and social channels with a REST API for tickets, customers, and automations.
auth_notes: REST API at developers.gorgias.com supports OAuth2 and API keys; app registration / API key creation in Gorgias settings.
self_serve_notes: Paid plans (with trial); API credentials available to any account, no sales gate.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Tickets, customers, messages, rules, macros, tags, users, integrations; 100+ endpoints with OpenAPI spec.

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP server found; community servers unverified.
